relations.text: シェルの米国子会社からピュージェット・サウンド製油所を買収(2021年11月)
relations.text_en: Bought the Puget Sound Refinery from Shell's US unit (November 2021)

source.label: HF Sinclair 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: HFS Puget Sound acquired the Puget Sound Refinery from Equilon Enterprises LLC dba Shell Oil Products US ("SOPUS") on November 1, 2021.

companies.name: グリーン・トレイル・フューエルズ

relations.text: コロラド・ニューメキシコの給油所の合弁(50%)を設立(2026年2月)
relations.text_en: Formed a 50% retail fuel joint venture in Colorado and New Mexico (February 2026)

source.label: HF Sinclair 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In February 2026, we announced the formation of Green Trail Fuels, LLC, a new joint venture in which we will hold a 50% non-operating economic interest.

relations.text: 自社株の相対買い戻しの相手として承認
relations.text_en: Authorized counterparty for privately negotiated share repurchases

source.label: HF Sinclair 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Privately negotiated repurchases from REH Advisors Inc.

relations.text: Yeswayが主な燃料の調達先の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Yesway names HF Sinclair among its main fuel suppliers

source.label: Yesway S-1/A(2026年4月)
source.quote: For our fuel supply, we partner with oil refiners, primarily Valero, Alon, and HF Sinclair.

relations.text: Calumetが10-Kで、潤滑油・パラフィンの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Calumet names HF Sinclair among primary lubricant and wax competitors

source.label: Calumet 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors in producing paraffin waxes include Exxon Mobil Corporation, HF Sinclair Corporation, The International Group Inc. and Ergon, Inc.
